text.text: Cisco Nexus 9000 Series Switches include both modular (Cisco Nexus 9500 Series Switches) and fixed switches (Cisco Nexus 9300 Series Switches) that deliver a flexible, agile, low-cost application-centric infrastructure.These switches address challenges related to application deployment, provisioning and scaling concerns in a physical, virtual and multi-tenant cloud environments.

text.text: The Cisco Nexus 9508 Switch is part of the Cisco Nexus 9000 Series switches that are the foundation for a flexible, agile, application centric infrastructure (ACI). The Cisco Nexus 9508 Switch is a modular switch supporting non-blocking configurations of up to 64 ports of 100G, 288 ports of 40G, 1,152 ports of 10G. The switch is ideal as 1/10GBase-T End-of-Row (EoR), 40G Aggregation, or 10/40G access/aggregation switch. The Nexus 9508 can be used for Nexus 2000 aggregation. Cisco provides 2 operating modes for the switch - NX-OS mode and ACI mode.

text.text: The Cisco Nexus 9508 Switch provides state of the art mechanical design. It is the first modular switch chassis that has no mid-plane. The line cards are directly connecting with the fabric modules via high speed connectors. This design allows for optimal airflow through the chassis. In addition, future upgrades of fabric modules and/or line cards to higher speed does NOT require a mid-plane replacement as typical today in other switches.

text.text: The Cisco Nexus 9508 Switch has 2 redundant System Controllers located at the rear of the chassis. The system controller is responsible for the chassis management including fan speed control, power supply management, and out-of-band control plane.

text.text: The Cisco Nexus 9508 Switch has up to 6 fabric modules that are located at the rear of the chassis behind the 3 fan trays. Each fan tray covers 2 fabric modules. Each fabric module provides up to 5.12 Tbps of bandwidth and is connected directly to each linecard in the chassis. Customers need all 6 fabric modules to provide non-blocking performance for the 36 port 40G QSFP+ linecard. For the other line cards only 2-4 fabric modules are required.
